en.text: HKALE 2006 Paper 1 Q11

zh.text: 香港高級程度會考 2006 卷一 第 11 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about interest are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪些有關利息的陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
Interest is a premium received for postponing current consumption.

zh.text: 利息是就延遲當時消費所收取的一個溢價。

en.text: An interest rate does not exist in a barter economy.

zh.text: 在以物易物經濟中，利率並不存在。

en.text: A fall in the interest rate increases present consumption.

zh.text: 利率下降會增加現時的消費。

en.text: HKDSE Practice Paper Paper 1 Q3

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 練習卷 卷一 第 3 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about interest is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項關於利息的陳述是正確的？

en.text: People will reduce current consumption when the interest rate drops.

zh.text: 當利率下跌時，人們便會減少現時的消費。

en.text: The interest rate will be zero if there is no inflation.

zh.text: 若沒有通脹，利率便會是零。

en.text: Interest does not exist in a planned economy.

zh.text: 在計劃經濟中，利息不存在。

en.text: Interest still exists without money.

zh.text: 沒有貨幣，利息仍然存在。

en.text: Which of the following statements about interest are correct?

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
Interest is the compensation for deferring consumption.

zh.text: 利息是延後消費的補償。

en.text: Interest exists because people are impatient to wait.

zh.text: 因為人們沒有耐性等待，所以利息存在。

zh.text: 利息在以物易物的經濟中存在。

en.text: Which of the following statements about interest is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項有關利息的陳述是正確的？

en.text: Without money, interest does not exist.

zh.text: 沒有貨幣，利息不會存在。

en.text: Without inflation, interest does not exist.

zh.text: 沒有通脹，利息不會存在。

en.text: Without scarcity, interest does not exist.

zh.text: 沒有稀少性，利息不會存在。

en.text: Interest is the compensation paid to the borrower for delayed consumption.

zh.text: 利息是對借款人延遲消費的補償。

en.text: For some types of dry-cured ham (風乾火腿), their flavour improves as they are air-dried for a longer time, and therefore can be sold at higher prices.

zh.text: 某些類型的風乾火腿隨着風乾時間的增加，其風味會提升，並因此能以更高的價格出售。

en.text: In this case, interest is ______ because ______.
involved ... consumers are willing to pay higher prices for deferring consumption

zh.text: 涉及 …… 消費者願意為延後消費支付更高的價格

en.text: involved ... dry-cured ham producers receive compensation for obtaining income later

zh.text: 涉及 …… 風乾火腿的生產者因較遲得到收入而獲得補償

en.text: not involved ... extending the curing time of ham does not affect their production costs

zh.text: 不涉及 …… 延長火腿的風乾時間並不影響其生產成本

en.text: not involved ... no borrowing or lending activities are involved

zh.text: 不涉及 …… 沒有涉及任何借貸活動
